scope: Independent read-only source review of frozen registration coordinator, physical-parent namespace, explicit adoption and acknowledged/ambiguous source-binding publication behavior. No tests or builds were executed by this review.

findings.result: Canonical parent and bounded lowercase ASCII/digit/._- basename policy prevents supported case aliases. The immutable coordination lane is derived from physical parent dev/ino/uid plus the length-framed basename, not parent spelling.
Authenticated binding pins exact raw absolute source spelling, exact request digest and lock dev/ino/uid. A mismatched alias binding cannot resume after lease handoff.

Lease acquisition precedes request validation. Fresh requires absent binding and source; Resume requires both and exact authenticated semantic source. Orphan binding cannot authorize source creation or silent restart.

Explicit adoption authenticates and semantically validates the whole staged source before binding publication, then requires exact source readback under the held lease. It performs no transport callback.

Transport callbacks have binding, source-cut, staged-semantic and allowed-action checks before and after invocation. The first guard fault is retained rather than laundered as a generic callback failure.

Source store ownership prevents foreign-path/seed injection. Owned writes poison the lease before publication and refresh the source pin only after exact acknowledged physical and decoded readback. Failed writes stop subsequent callbacks.

Binding publication uses private synced temporary bytes and no-clobber hard-link publication. Failure after publication is ambiguous, poisons the invocation and requires explicit reload; no rollback is claimed.

New preparation entry returns at durable Prepared with no broadcast capability. Historical execute receives the same Saved watermark from the shared driver, preserving observed invocation-local advances and its old tail.

limitations: Supported source basenames are 1..128 bytes of lowercase ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; dot/dotdot, .lock suffix and .dpcreg1- prefix are refused.

Coordination covers cooperating local writers using the same physical private directory and allowed basename. Direct historical RecoveryStore/execute or raw helper calls that bypass the coordinator remain outside this lease guarantee.

Changing physical parent identity changes the coordination lane. Directory rename or alternate spelling may retain the physical lane but the exact raw source-path binding refuses mismatch. Moved/copied cuts require explicit reconciliation or adoption as applicable; Resume never silently reconstructs missing binding.
Adoption requires quiescent historical writers. There is no hostile same-user/filesystem fencing, distributed/NFS coordination, rollback freshness or global copied-request deduplication claim.

After-publication errors require stopping and reloading the visible authenticated cut. Old bytes are guaranteed only for definite pre-publication failure; no automatic rollback or universal old-bytes claim applies.

The original saved anchors form the restart finality baseline. Higher tips observed later are invocation-local and are not persisted across restart; no ancestry or real consensus authentication is claimed.

A failed Prepared save may repeat mock prove from ReportsObserved. No exactly-once proof, registration across arbitrary copies, signed transaction, broadcast outcome or global delivery claim is made by this preparation coordinator.
This is cfg(test) software with caller-owned offline mock observations/proof responses. Real DON/RPC/SP1 proof, deployment activation and vault custody remain outside the reviewed packet.
